Subject: Trial kickoff & hands-on session: staging access + load test agenda

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We'd like to lock in a hands-on kickoff this week or early next week to validate routing and run a short load test. Goals:
- Walk through prompt templates and routing variants we plan to use (chat -> rerank -> generation limits)
- Smoke test staging endpoints and confirm KV/prefix caching behavior
- Run a 15-minute load test (roughly 400–600 req/min) to observe latency and throttling behavior

To get us ready we need: a sandbox API key (scoped), a staging endpoint URL, and an IP allowlist file (our network team will add Redwood's IPs). Can your team pre-provision a scoped key and share the allowlist template?

Availability from our side:
- Wed 2026-06-02: 10:00–12:00 PT or 15:00–17:00 PT
- Thu 2026-06-03: 09:00–11:00 PT

If none of those work, please propose two alternate 1-hour windows. Also, if there are any constraints on load testing (burst limits, pre-approval), call that out so we can coordinate with our infra.

Thanks — looking forward to a productive session.

Chris Dalton
Head of Data Platform, SignalGrid

Hi Chris / Vanessa —

I'll handle the staging setup. Quick notes and steps below so your network and infra teams have everything they need: 

- Staging endpoints (read-only examples for the trial):
  • API base: https://staging-api.redwood-inference.com/v1
  • Chat endpoint: /chat/stream
  • Embeddings endpoint: /embeddings

- Scoped sandbox API key: I will create a token named signalgrid-eval and limit it to 30 minutes after the scheduled session time by default. If you want the token kept longer for post-session tests, say the timeframe and we can extend.

- Allowlist / network details: attached allowlist-template.txt — add these Redwood source IPs to your office/VPC NAT allowlist: 34.198.112.22, 52.44.15.101, 18.205.93.11. We use TLS only (port 443). No inbound ports required on your side.

- Load test guidance: 500 req/min should be fine for a short run. We'll enable a temporary quota bump tied to the token for the 15-minute window. Please confirm the highest concurrency you plan to use per client (we recommend spreading requests across 4–8 client threads to avoid simulated queuing artifacts).

- Prompt & KV notes: If you plan to test prefix caching, include a variety of prompt prefix lengths (short: <64 tokens; long: 512+ tokens) so we can observe cache behavior and token cost. We'll capture latency percentiles and token billing estimates during the run.

Attachments: redwood-env-checklist.csv, allowlist-template.txt

Example curl (token placeholder):
curl -X POST 
  "https://staging-api.redwood-inference.com/v1/chat/stream" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <signalgrid-eval>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"prompt":"Review this routing rule...","max_tokens":256}'

Thanks — I'll provision the token after you confirm which proposed time you prefer and the IPs.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
